# Deprecate Workflow

1. Resolve the immutable skill and a current nondeprecated successor in the same
   plugin or project origin.
2. Reject self-successors and every successor cycle.
3. Record reviewed audit metadata, the successor, and an immutable digest of the
   exact deprecation record. An active skill receives a migration warning.
4. Publish provenance, project registry metadata when applicable, catalog,
   manifest, and desired projections through the common transaction.
